actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 417 - 0 (Roll no. 54). (text: CR H932)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 417 - 0 (Roll no. 54). (text: CR H932)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H937-938)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 856.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H932-933)
Mr. Comer moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.

committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the Director of the Office of Management and Budget and defense and civilian federal agencies.
dimensions.evidence: The Director shall review the procurement management practices of Defense and Civilian agencies

dimensions.assessment: Mandates an administrative review and reporting requirement without directly altering procurement rules or funding.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the enactment of this Act, the Director shall submit a report on the results of the review

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state any fiscal or spending implications.
Directs a specific executive branch review and congressional report concerning federal acquisition regulations.
dimensions.evidence: The Director shall review the procurement management practices of Defense and Civilian agencies to determine whether the provisions... have created any national security risk.

dimensions.assessment: Requires a one-time report to be delivered within 180 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the enactment of this Act, the Director shall submit a report

importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Office of Management and Budget to conduct a review and submit a report within 180 days on whether certain federal acquisition regulations create national security risks.
